name: Ferretti S.p.A.
summary: Ferretti S.p.A., founded in 1968 and based in Forli, Italy, designs, builds, markets and sells yachts and vessels under brands such as Riva, Wally, Ferretti Yachts, Pershing, Itama, CRN and Custom Line. It makes luxury composite, made-to-measure and super yachts, owns shipyards, and provides brokerage, chartering, management, refitting and after-sales services. It operates in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific and the Americas.
